name: dioscorea villosa tuber + sodium chloride + strychnos nux-vomica seed
purpose: PURPOSE Constipation Relief Tablets Relieves: • Constipation • Bowel Irregularity • Bloating

otcwarn: WARNINGS If pregnant or breast-feeding , ask a health professional before use. Keep out of reach of children. If symptoms persist or worsen, a health professional should be consulted. Do not use if known sensitivity to BHI Constipation or any of its ingredients exists.
